name: atelier-vanguard
description: Atelier Vanguard — Luxury Minimalist Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix server run prisma:push && npm run seed
